outputs.survivor_line: market, rule, PF 1c and 2c, n, days

rules.two_sided: 0 < bid < ask < 1 for the side taken (rule 18)
rules.cheap_side: the lower ask of the two sides at the look (the YES ask against 1 minus the YES bid); a tie goes to YES
rules.look: the candle ending exactly at close minus 120 s (end_ts); none = no entry for that event (a candle exists only if the minute had a ladder row; its quote can be up to 59 s older than the candle end); no earlier candle is used
rules.exit_M60: the bid of the candle ending exactly at close minus 60 s; none = held to settlement (both printed); a missing candle at exactly that minute is not replaced by the previous one
rules.spread_filter: round trip spread (ask minus bid) of the side taken at most 0.03 (a number, fixed now)
rules.void: a void result is passed through by the loader and scored: the price is refunded and the fee kept
